subject.title: config/io: add proper logging for IO error handling

question: Which config IO best-effort failures should this PR make operator-visible before merge, and should the scope stay logging-only?
rationale: Config IO fallback behavior is compatibility-sensitive, and the linked issue also proposes retries and a strict mode beyond the narrow logging patch.

options.title: Narrow to safe logging
options.body: Log actionable audit, backup, and health-state write failures through bootstrap-safe paths while leaving best-effort semantics non-fatal and deferring retry or strict mode.

options.title: Hold for broader IO policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define the full config IO observability, retry, and strict-mode policy on the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Narrow to safe logging
recommendation.body: Log actionable audit, backup, and health-state write failures through bootstrap-safe paths while leaving best-effort semantics non-fatal and deferring retry or strict mode.
